proposed_widenings.name: triggered_response_ability
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines ordinary charge-based activation with a trigger-bound property that fires on a failed save but does not spend a reaction. The current non-spell triggered family is hard-coded to reaction consumption, so there is no honest mechanics family for this property.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn."

proposed_widenings.name: override_triggering_save_outcome
proposed_widenings.justification: The missing property does not negate or reflect the triggering spell; it rewrites the already-resolved save result from failure to success. Existing atoms cover negating a triggering spell and reflecting a triggering spell, but not changing the triggering save outcome itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can turn your failed save into a successful one"

notes: Cast Spell fits an activation + charge_pool item part, and Reflect Enchantment fits a triggered reaction item part using the existing spell_save_outcome trigger and reflect_triggering_spell atom. Resist Enchantment is a core omitted rider and cannot be represented honestly with the current families, so no Dhall/JSON/trace content file was authored.
